lead.headline: Army detonates 68 barrels of unstable lead azide at Iowa plant
lead.dek: EPA monitors found no airborne lead in the first hours; residents within 5 miles had been told to leave
body: The Army detonated 68 barrels of deteriorating, recrystallized lead azide, approximately 5 tons, at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant in Middletown, southeastern Iowa, on Wednesday after a federal appeals court authorized the detonation and authorities urged a 5-mile evacuation.

The EPA said four air monitoring stations detected no lead 15 minutes after the 9 a.m. blast, and FEMA issued an all clear around the plant. Maj. Gen. Eric Shirley, who led the operation, said the risk had been cut "as close to zero as is absolutely humanly possible." The Army said the material, stored there since 2009, had recrystallized and could not be moved safely.

The 8th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals had blocked the detonation before lifting its order Monday, finding an uncontrolled explosion would do more harm. The EPA said dust wipe results are due in the coming days. NBC News reported properties found above 200 parts per million of lead would be cleaned at government expense. FEMA is housing evacuees in hotels through Friday.

briefs.headline: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade to Saturday over storm
briefs.summary: Macy's moved its 100th parade to 8:30 a.m. Saturday as a storm with gusts to 65 mph neared New York; Gov. Kathy Hochul declared a state of emergency.

briefs.headline: Judge pauses order to hand over Fulton 2020 ballot copies
briefs.summary: Judge Kelly Lee Ellerbe stayed her own order hours before a 5 p.m. Wednesday handover to the State Election Board, pending Fulton County's appeal.

briefs.headline: Trump proposes Section 301 tariffs on China, EU and 12 others
briefs.summary: The administration named 14 trading partners, with China at 20% on top of existing duties; the S&P 500 closed down 0.25% and the Nasdaq fell 0.6%.

briefs.headline: Judge blocks FCC review of ABC licenses as likely retaliation
briefs.summary: Judge Loren AliKhan found ABC likely to show the early review of its eight station licenses was retaliatory, citing 11 Trump calls to pull them.

briefs.headline: Israeli judges urge dropping Netanyahu's main bribery case
briefs.summary: Jerusalem District Court judges said Wednesday conviction chances in Case 4000 were low and urged prosecutors to reconsider the bribery charge.

briefs.headline: Fuel truck fire on Cairo ring road kills at least 31
briefs.summary: A petroleum truck overturned and exploded on Greater Cairo's ring road, killing 31 and injuring 21, Egypt's Health Ministry said.

briefs.headline: EU leaders open summit split on budget and Ukraine loan
briefs.summary: Leaders met Thursday on a 1.7 trillion euro seven-year budget and a 45 billion euro Ukraine loan; Slovakia, Hungary and Czechia oppose the loan.

briefs.headline: Kim tours nuclear fuel plants, calls for larger arsenal
briefs.summary: KCNA said Kim Jong Un toured two fissile material plants Wednesday and called for deploying low-yield battlefield weapons; Seoul said it is ready.

briefs.headline: Court orders marshals to collect $8.2M from Justice
briefs.summary: A federal writ of execution directs the U.S. Marshal to seize about $8.29M in goods from Sen. Jim Justice and four coal firms for a surety company.

briefs.headline: S&P raises West Virginia bond rating to AA
briefs.summary: The upgrade from AA- is the state's first general obligation increase in 15 years; S&P cited $2B in reserves and $371M in surplus revenue.

briefs.headline: Barboursville moves to sue state over youth facility
briefs.summary: The village gave notice it will sue the Department of Human Services to block a 36-bed psychiatric facility a Utah operator would run in a city park.

briefs.headline: Judge approves $950,000 settlement in trooper shooting
briefs.summary: The suit over the May 2024 killing of Justin Grant, 44, by state police in Greenbrier County said the 'deadly weapon' was a small gardening tool.

regional.item: Milton delivered bottled water to customers hit by an outage and low pressure, with no repair estimate before Monday.
A head-on crash on U.S. 60 near Cedar Grove killed a woman Wednesday and closed the highway for about five hours.
A federal grant will pay to design the Harmar Bridge reopening in Marietta ahead of a $12M campaign launching Dec. 1.

away.item: Police told the Banner Monday the Route 67A 'Peanut' rotary is cutting serious crashes despite tire complaints.

hotspots.item: County commissioners said Nov. 18 that a Nov. 13 court status hearing left the Camden-on-Gauley water system's receivership unchanged.
North Topsail Beach closed Beach Accesses 3 and 46 and shut New River Inlet Road to non-residents toward Access 3 Wednesday, citing flooding and nor'easter damage.

briefs.headline: Ottawa adds $10.7M sockeye wing to Prince George hatchery
briefs.summary: Fisheries Minister Joanne Thompson said the Upper Fraser hatchery, built with the Lheidli T'enneh, will rear sockeye as well as chinook from 2028.

briefs.headline: Prince George man gets 15-plus years in fentanyl cases
briefs.summary: Cody Allen Stovin, 44, was sentenced after RCMP seized 800 grams of drugs and a gun in 2022 and nearly 1,250 grams of fentanyl, meth and cocaine in 2023.

briefs.headline: Orange flood warning puts Vancouver's tide peak at 8:40 a.m.
briefs.summary: Environment Canada expects moderate to significant coastal flooding Thursday with 30 to 60 mm more rain; the city calls it a four-year high water level.

briefs.headline: U.S. prosecutors oppose bail for Tumbler Ridge co-accused
briefs.summary: A Seattle filing Wednesday says James Bryant, 30, traded nearly 74,000 texts with the shooter, tested livestream gear and helped start the car Feb. 10.

briefs.headline: Supreme Court rules on Quebec's Bill 21 at 9:45 a.m. Friday
briefs.summary: The 2019 secularism law bars religious symbols for some public servants and sits behind the notwithstanding clause; the court heard four days of argument.

briefs.headline: Commons defeats Tory motion against 662,000-resident plan
briefs.summary: The Bloc sided with the Conservatives; the NDP and Green MP Elizabeth May backed the Liberals. Ottawa says most of those gaining status already live here.

briefs.headline: Hera returns first images of DART crater on Dimorphos
briefs.summary: ESA's spacecraft shows a stadium-sized crater spanning the moonlet, which now tumbles in its orbit. Hera closes to 13 km from the pair in December.

briefs.headline: FCC clears SpaceX to deploy 1 million Starmind satellites
briefs.summary: The commission approved the orbital AI data-center constellation Wednesday. SpaceX targets first launches on Starship in the third quarter of 2027.

briefs.headline: Deer bones hint humans reached Ireland 13,500 years ago
briefs.summary: Liverpool John Moores researchers report possible butchery marks on giant deer bones from a Waterford cave, almost 1,000 years before known evidence.

briefs.headline: Physicists entangle 123 atom qubits in optical lattice
briefs.summary: A team including Jian-Wei Pan verified entanglement across 123 rubidium orbit qubits with about 95% gate fidelity, in Physical Review Letters.

briefs.headline: 42 attorneys general oppose Character.AI chat data sale
briefs.summary: A California-led coalition asked the bankruptcy court to block a Dec. 1 auction of chat logs from 21 million US accounts, 2.1 million of them minors.

briefs.headline: Uttar Pradesh tenders AI system linked to family ID data
briefs.summary: A 178-page tender in India's most populous state would link agency records to monitor social media and route complaints; critics say no law allows it.

briefs.headline: NERC adopts first grid reliability rules for data centers
briefs.summary: Sites of 50 MW or more must share power models and follow grid operators' orders under October rules awaiting FERC approval, IEEE Spectrum reported Tuesday.
